newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea KFA delays corn, barley tenders to Sept 17.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea KFA delays corn, barley tenders to Sept 17.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association (KFA) has postponed tenders for buying 35,000 tonnes of feed corn and 15,000 tonnes of feed barley to September 17 from its earlier plan for September 11, an KFA official said on Monday.
The official said it will invite tenders by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) next Tuesday.
Earlier, traders in Seoul said invitations for the tenders were due by 2:00 p.m. on Wednesday this week.
If feed barley prices are lower than those of corn, traders said the KFA would probably buy an additional 35,000 tonnes of barley and cancel corn purchases.
Deliveries would be set for December 5 to the western port of Inchon, traders said.
